Wait until the Password field is visible.

Wait until the Appointment Booking page is displayed.

User confirms that all displayed appointment information is correct.
Appointment booking process is completed successfully.

Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Successful Appointment Booking with Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center and Medicaid
Module: Appointment Booking
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User has access to the CURA Healthcare application.
- User is on the application home screen.
- "John Doe" is a registered user with valid credentials.

Test Steps:
1. Tap on the Make Appointment button on the home screen.
2. Wait until the Username field is visible.
3. Enter "John Doe" in the Username field.
4. Wait until the Password field is visible.
5. Enter "ThisIsNotAPassword" in the Password field.
6. Tap on the Login button.
7. Wait until the Appointment Booking page is displayed.
8. Select "Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center" from the Facility dropdown.
9. Select "Medicaid" as the healthcare program.
10. Select a future date from the Visit Date selector.
11. Enter "I have very high fever." in the Comment field.
12. Review the appointment details.
13. Tap on the Book Appointment button.
14. Wait until the Appointment Confirmation page is displayed.
15. Verify that the appointment confirmation displays:
    - Healthcare Facility: Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center
    - Healthcare Program: Medicaid
    - Visit Date: Matches the previously selected future date
    - Comment: I have very high fever

Expected Result:
- The user is directed to the Appointment Booking page after a successful login.
- The selected Facility, Healthcare Program, Visit Date, and Comment fields display the correct values on the Confirmation page.
- The Appointment Confirmation page confirms the booking and shows all submitted details accurately.
- The appointment booking process completes successfully with a confirmation message.
